decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cooler in a project-based industrial market, it remains inexpensive to keep available and after only two selling cycles there is still enough unresolved demand uncertainty to justify keeping the option open.

This condenser is still worth keeping as the remaining option in that adjacent niche, but after the earlier withdrawal of the similar Product B the pressure to rationalize the condenser offer keeps its drop probability the highest in the group.
The tube-liner retrofit fits the firm's repair and lifecycle-service business closely, so carrying it likely costs little while corrosion-related aftermarket demand can still scale further.
The customized air-cooler line matches the firm's solution-oriented strategy and broad customer base especially well, making continued market presence the most valuable choice.
These repair inserts complement installed-base service work and require limited incremental commitment, so management would keep them while learning the depth of recurring maintenance demand.
